mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `user` (username, email, password_hash, nickname, status, is_deleted) VALUES (#{username}, #{email}, #{passwordHash}, #{nickname}, #{status}, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM `user` WHERE username = #{username} AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM `user` WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT id FROM `user` WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND status = 0 ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE `user` SET password_hash = #{passwordHash}, gmt_modified = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE `user` SET deactivated_at = #{deactivatedAt}, cooling_off_expires_at = #{coolingOffExpiresAt}, deactivation_revoked_at = NULL, gmt_modified = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE `user` SET deactivation_revoked_at = #{revokedAt}, gmt_modified = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0 AND deactivated_at IS NOT NULL AND deactivation_revoked_at IS NULL
UPDATE `user` SET nickname = NULL, avatar_url = NULL, phone = NULL, email = NULL, password_hash = 'DEACTIVATED', status = 1, gmt_modified = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM `user` WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND status = 0 AND deactivated_at IS NOT NULL AND cooling_off_expires_at IS NOT NULL AND cooling_off_expires_at <= NOW() AND deactivation_revoked_at IS NULL LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(1) > 0 FROM `user` WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0 AND deactivated_at IS NOT NULL AND cooling_off_expires_at IS NOT NULL AND deactivation_revoked_at IS NULL AND cooling_off_expires_at > NOW()
